events.description: Soothing Male Voice says Mom and Dad never forget the sound associated with childbirth.
Soothing Male Voice says the childbirth being described is the miracle of birth.
Teacher says the demonstration they just watched shows how people have a baby.
Teacher says next week will be the final class session for Teacher, Joey Tribbiani, and the other students.
Ross Geller tells Susan Bunch to go deep by moving farther away.
Carol Willick says that doing what Woman 1 did in the video—giving birth—is impossible.
Susan Bunch asks Carol Willick what Carol Willick finds impossible.
Carol Willick says Woman 1 gave birth in the video.
Carol Willick says Carol Willick is not going to do what Woman 1 did and give birth.
Carol Willick says the baby is going to have to stay inside Carol Willick.
Carol Willick says keeping the baby inside Carol Willick is all that will happen.
Carol Willick says everything will be the same.
Ross Geller says everything is going to be all right.
Carol Willick says Ross Geller does not know what the childbirth experience is like.
Carol Willick says no one is going up to Ross Geller and suggesting pushing a pot roast through Ross Geller's nostril.
Susan Bunch says she knows childbirth is frightening.
Susan Bunch says the birth part lasts only one day.
Susan Bunch says the birth will be over.
Susan Bunch says Susan Bunch, Ross Geller, and Carol Willick will be parents for the rest of their lives.
Susan Bunch says that becoming parents for the rest of their lives is what the childbirth experience is about.
